scripts.predeploy: [ "$(git branch --show-current)" = main ] && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { echo 'deploy only from a clean main checkout' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.postdeploy: curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'IndexNow: HTTP %{http_code} (200/202 = accepted)\n' -X POST https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' --data-binary @indexnow.json
